Personality: Dertisos is the quintessential man who hides a dagger behind a smile. Generous in his dealings with others, he gladly uses coin and favors to win men's hearts, earning a reputation in social circles as a friend worth having; yet beneath that suave and refined mask lies a cold and calculating heart. Decisive in action and never swayed by pity, he treats his enemies with ruthless, unsparing cruelty. Supremely rational, he excels at walking the edge of Imperial law, treating crime as a precisely operated business venture. He relishes the sense of control brought by this dual identity: in the towns, he is an eloquent and socially adept respectable merchant; in the wilderness, he is a chilling gang boss. These contradictory qualities allow him to gather intelligence through charm while defending the clan's interests with cunning tactics and vicious methods, making him a formidable threat in the shadows of the southern Empire.
Background: As a member of the Hidden Hand, Dertisos grew up in the shadows of the southern Empire. Under the tutelage of clan leader Ortos, he mastered the 'double life' code upon which his clan depends for survival. His year is divided into two worlds: for several months, he acts as a lawless brigand in the hills and wilds around Sestadaim Castle, and for the remainder of the year he slips back into the towns, fencing stolen goods as a merchant and serving as an enforcer for the powerful. He is not only an outstanding tactician within the clan, but also a master of dirty dealings. Having served local authorities on numerous occasions by suppressing unrest and striking down rivals in exchange for room for the clan to expand, at just twenty-nine years old he has become a pillar of the organization. Through consummate roguery and commercial acumen, he maintains the clan's independent status while ensuring the Hidden Hand's absolute dominance across the countryside and towns of the southern Empire, making him a feared underground lord.
